regime.name: BULL
regime.description: above the 200-day and participation is broad

indicators.label: Breadth non-confirmation, 63d count
indicators.note: days near a high with breadth already negative
indicators.check: This IS the price comparison, counted for you. A rising count is the November 2021 pattern: index still making highs, participation already gone. Zero is healthy.

indicators.label: Quality spread (CCC minus BB)
indicators.note: the junk end versus the decent end of high yield
indicators.check: Widening while equities hold up means risk appetite is leaving from the bottom. The weakest borrowers crack first, and this gap opens before the index-level spread does.

indicators.label: Stock/bond correlation, 63d
indicators.note: above zero means bonds stop cushioning equities
indicators.check: Check this before you need the hedge, not after. It says nothing about whether a drawdown is coming, only what it will cost you.

indicators.label: VIX level
indicators.check: Direction against price is what counts. VIX rising while the index also rises is rare and is worth stopping on.

indicators.label: VVIX (vol of vol)
indicators.note: rises when people start paying up for tail protection
indicators.check: Rising VVIX with a flat VIX means someone is buying protection before any move shows in price. This leads more often than VIX does.

indicators.label: VIX / VIX3M term structure
indicators.note: above 1.00 = backwardation, the classic risk-off trigger
indicators.check: Crossing 1.00 while the index is still near its highs is the meaningful case. Above 1.00 during an active selloff is normal and usually marks the panic, not the start of one.

indicators.label: HY OAS, 20-day change
indicators.check: Positive while the index makes new highs is the single most reliable non-confirmation in this whole panel.

indicators.label: % of S&P 500 above 20-day average
indicators.check: Short-horizon. Under 15% is washout territory -- check whether price has actually broken structure or merely dipped.

indicators.label: Defensives vs index, 63d
indicators.note: utilities and staples relative to the index
indicators.check: Rising while the index makes highs means money is moving to safety inside the rally. Confirms more often than it leads.

indicators.label: New 52w highs minus new lows
indicators.check: Negative while the index is at a new high is the textbook non-confirmation. It was present at 1972, 2000, 2007 and 2021.

indicators.label: Advance/decline line, 63d z-score
indicators.note: low = participation narrowing under the surface
indicators.check: Negative while the index sits at highs is the divergence that matters. Negative during a pullback is just a pullback.

indicators.label: Financial conditions (NFCI)
indicators.check: Tightening while the index is at highs is a warning. Loosening during a selloff usually marks the end of it. Weekly, so treat it as background rather than a trigger.

indicators.label: VIX9D / VIX near-term stress
indicators.check: Rising while price is flat means a dated event is being priced -- look for what is on the calendar rather than on the chart.

indicators.label: VVIX / VIX
indicators.check: High ratio with a low VIX = complacent spot, expensive tails. Protection is cheapest to own exactly here.

indicators.label: Credit non-confirmation, 63d count
indicators.note: days near a high with credit spreads widening
indicators.check: Counts the days equities made highs while credit disagreed. This led 2000, 2007, 2018 and 2021-22. A count climbing off zero is the thing to watch.

indicators.label: Cap-weight vs equal-weight, 63d
indicators.note: rising = the index is being carried by fewer names
indicators.check: Compare directly with the index. Both rising together means the gain is narrowing into a handful of names.

indicators.label: High yield OAS
indicators.note: credit is usually early to price real trouble
indicators.check: The level matters less than the direction. Check it every time the index prints a new high.

indicators.label: Fed net liquidity, 63d change
indicators.note: reserves less the Treasury account less reverse repo
indicators.check: Falling while the index makes highs means the advance is running on positioning rather than on new money. Short history and contested -- treat as supporting evidence, never as a trigger.

indicators.label: MOVE (rates volatility)
indicators.check: If this leads VIX higher, the shock is coming from bonds or policy rather than from equities -- a different playbook.

signals.label: Volatility term structure reset
signals.meaning: panic priced in and now unwinding — historically a buy window

signals.label: Term structure inverted
signals.meaning: near-term risk priced above 3-month — risk-off trigger

signals.label: Breadth washout
signals.meaning: selling exhausted, breadth turning up off the floor

signals.label: Breadth thrust
signals.meaning: rare, powerful buying surge — strongly bullish

signals.label: Major top cluster
signals.meaning: tail hedging bid, bonds no longer cushioning, price at highs

quality.headline: Something is off — read the notes before trusting the score.

checks.name: Breadth not pinned at a suspicious extreme
checks.detail: breadth readings look like real data

checks.name: Breadth gauges agree
checks.detail: participation measures tell the same story

pivots.note: Lows are the easy test and should be near-perfect. Tops are the hard test — judge the tool on that column.
